Independent_Variable: Fleet_Standardization_Program
Current_Fleet_Status
Efficiency_Metrics
2035_Strategic_Goals
DEPENDENT_VARIABLE_DEFINITIONS:
Non_Standard_Vessels_Removed = Number of non-compliant ships retired or scrapped
Safety_Improvement_Index = Measure of accident reduction and safety compliance improvement
Cost_Reduction_Percentage = Decline in operational costs due to standardization
Total_Active_Vessels = Total number of licensed commercial vessels operating
Percentage_Standardized = Proportion of fleet meeting national standards
Average_Vessel_Tonnage = Mean cargo capacity of the fleet (increasing over time)
Fleet_Efficiency_Rating = Overall performance score for fleet operations
Carbon_Intensity = Emissions per unit of cargo transported
Energy_Efficiency = Relative efficiency compared to alternative transport modes
Fuel_Consumption = Amount of fuel required per unit of cargo
Emissions_Reduction_Rate = Annual percentage decrease in greenhouse gas emissions
INDEPENDENT_VARIABLE_DEFINITIONS:
Standardization_Program_Phase = Period during which standardization initiatives occurred
Modernization_Level = Degree to which fleet has adopted modern technology
Vessel_Type = Category of ship (standardized vs non-standard)
Technology_Adoption = Implementation of AI
Policy_Incentive = Government subsidies or regulations driving change
